name: openflywheel
description: Initialize ITSM-bench harness workspaces, query Langfuse trajectories, and record authoritative verifier outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Initialize ITSM workspaces and inspect traces
interface.longDescription: Initialize an ITSM-bench agent-harness optimization workspace, select and inspect bounded Langfuse trajectory evidence, and record authoritative external-verifier outcomes on exact traces.
defaultPrompt: Read this repository, identify the primary agent harness the user wants to evaluate with ITSM-bench, and use $workspace-init to collect its experiment configuration and perform the initial setup.
When PROGRAM.md is ready, read it and continue the optimization loop until its declared goal or stop condition is met.
